evidence: Has P2P and Private Broadcast labels; modifies private broadcast queue lifecycle and retention in src/private_broadcast.* and net processing.
rationale: Retaining finished private broadcast transactions resolves caller ambiguity when querying broadcast status. Previously, transactions were dropped upon receipt from peers, meaning 'callers and node operators querying getprivatebroadcastinfo could not distinguish between a successful broadcast, an unqueued transaction, or an interrupted broadcast.' While a worthwhile observability enhancement for private broadcast users, it is reasonably deferrable.
